meta.note: v1 target system (supersedes v0.1 captured from code on 2026-10-03)

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light: warm chalk. Dark: onyx near-black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, sheets, nav bars.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs, toasts — anything floating.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: code/ID blocks, table header rows, skeletons, input groups.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted band: invitation hero, primary button fill, toast.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken (≥15:1 both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, helper text, metadata (≥6:1).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, timestamps, legal footers (≥4.6:1 on every ground).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules. Decorative — not a control boundary.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries: inputs, checkboxes, radio, toggles off, secondary buttons (≥3:1 on every ground).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in the ground colour. Ink, not accent, so it reads on finance screens too.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Rani — the funky signature. Status moments, invitations, the wordmark mark, the Icon tier. Max one accent element per view; never on financial-eligibility surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind accent text (accent on accent-soft ≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text/icon on an accent fill (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Brass — the classy accent. Membership details, Member-tier mark, eyebrows on editorial pages, sequential chart ramp.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind brass text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, verified, consent active. Always with an icon + word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success alert/badge ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention, pending review, expiring consent.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alert/badge ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, fraud flags. Vermilion — kept orange-red so it never reads as Rani.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger alert/badge ground.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information, disclosures, 'Subject to partner-lender approval' notes.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info alert/badge ground; the disclosure panel on eligibility results.

tokens.name: tier-member-base
tokens.usage: Member card/badge material: matte chalk.

tokens.name: tier-member-edge
tokens.usage: Member card edge and badge border.

tokens.name: tier-member-ink
tokens.usage: Type on Member material (≥13:1).

tokens.name: tier-member-mark
tokens.usage: Member mark: brass foil.

tokens.name: tier-onyx-base
tokens.usage: Onyx card/badge material: matte black, faint grain.

tokens.name: tier-onyx-edge
tokens.usage: Onyx edge line — keeps the black card visible on the dark canvas.

tokens.name: tier-onyx-ink
tokens.usage: Type on Onyx material.

tokens.name: tier-onyx-mark
tokens.usage: Onyx mark: graphite silver.

tokens.name: tier-icon-base
tokens.usage: Icon card/badge material: smoked titanium.

tokens.name: tier-icon-sheen
tokens.usage: Icon brushed-metal highlight (the one sanctioned two-stop gradient, card art only).

tokens.name: tier-icon-edge
tokens.usage: Icon edge line.

tokens.name: tier-icon-ink
tokens.usage: Type on Icon material.

tokens.name: tier-icon-mark
tokens.usage: Icon mark: a single Rani foil line. The only place Rani appears on metal.

tokens.name: card-graphite
tokens.usage: Co-branded payment card finish A (cardholder choice, independent of Creator Status).

tokens.name: card-chalk
tokens.usage: Co-branded payment card finish B.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (brass). Fixed order; never cycled. Text never wears series colours.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (slate blue).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (clay).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (teal).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (plum). A 6th series folds into 'Other'.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and axis rules — recessive.

tokens.name: chart-diverge-neg
tokens.usage: Diverging negative pole (clay).

tokens.name: chart-diverge-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging neutral midpoint.

tokens.name: chart-diverge-pos
tokens.usage: Diverging positive pole (slate).

tokens.name: seq-100
tokens.usage: Sequential brass ramp for magnitude (heatmaps, completeness). Ordinal use starts at seq-200.

tokens.name: seq-200
tokens.usage: Sequential brass ramp for magnitude (heatmaps, completeness). Ordinal use starts at seq-200.

tokens.name: seq-300
tokens.usage: Sequential brass ramp for magnitude (heatmaps, completeness). Ordinal use starts at seq-200.

tokens.name: seq-400
tokens.usage: Sequential brass ramp for magnitude (heatmaps, completeness). Ordinal use starts at seq-200.

tokens.name: seq-500
tokens.usage: Sequential brass ramp for magnitude (heatmaps, completeness). Ordinal use starts at seq-200.

tokens.name: seq-600
tokens.usage: Sequential brass ramp for magnitude (heatmaps, completeness). Ordinal use starts at seq-200.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans Devanagari", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Invitation and status-reveal hero only. 88px from lg. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles on editorial screens (dashboard greeting, Passport name). 64px from lg.

styles.name: display-italic
styles.usage: The swagger move: one italic phrase inside a display line. Never a whole paragraph.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page heading on product screens. 44px from lg.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We look at the business you've built — not the follower count.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your progress saves after every step.

styles.name: body-hi
styles.sample: आपकी प्रगति हर चरण के बाद सहेजी जाती है।
styles.usage: Hindi body — same size, taller line-height for matras.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button text, tab labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, errors, disclosures, table cells in the risk console.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase context label above headings. Latin only — never uppercase-transform Hindi.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Amounts in rows and tables. tabular-nums, right-aligned.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: IDs, reason codes, model versions, consent hashes, card numbers.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: chart bar spacer, badge inner.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon–text gap in badges; base unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label → control; chip gaps; inline groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row vertical padding; button-group gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; control horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Mobile page margin (gutter to screen edge).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; section inner spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between related sections on mobile; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Heading block → content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between major sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Editorial breathing room: hero padding, invitation screen.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, inline code, table chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, OTP cells, alerts, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets' inner panels, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature cards, opportunity cards, dialogs, bottom-sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Membership and payment card art (ISO ID-1 corner at 340px wide).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (pills), badges, chips, toggles, avatars, bottom-nav indicator.

shadow.note: Depth is quiet. Pages use borders; only floating layers and metal cards cast shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Pressed/raised controls, sticky bars on scroll.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Membership/payment card art only: lift plus a top-edge metal highlight.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and inputs (risk console, toolbars).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height on mobile — comfortable thumb target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary CTA at the bottom of mobile flows.

tokens.name: otp-cell
tokens.usage: OTP digit cell width and height.

tokens.name: bottom-nav
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom navigation height (plus safe-area inset).

tokens.name: top-bar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width (72px collapsed).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Desktop content max width (12-col, 24px gutters).

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width for forms, consent text and flows.

tokens.name: card-art
tokens.usage: Membership card art width on mobile; height = width / 1.586.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, small state changes.

tokens.name: duration-calm
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, tab content, toasts.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Signature moments only: status reveal, card reveal.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for UI motion.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving the screen.

tokens.name: ease-reveal
tokens.usage: Signature reveal: slow, weighted, settles without bounce.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Top bar, bottom nav, sidebar.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.
